what_is_it.explanation: Treg acts as an OpenRouter equivalent specifically for agent tools, routing requests to thousands of endpoints across multiple providers with pay-per-call pricing. It allows agents and developers to call APIs, use skills, and run CLIs without managing individual vendor accounts, signup walls, or costly subscriptions. A single token and base URL authenticate callers while treg handles server-side credential injection and request relaying.
